one_black_vertex.proof: B=C*(x-lambda)^29 would force the negative real ratio (1-lambda)/(-lambda) to have 29th power one

passport_census.marking_convention: B(lambda)=0; B/W record the colours of source points x=0,x=1; cycle identities with equal valency are quotient out, while endpoint order is retained

problem.question: does a normalized degree-29 Belyi polynomial map lambda to 0 or 1?

theorem.proved: every degree-29 witness has at least three vertices in the colour containing lambda; if it has exactly three, both x=0 and x=1 have the opposite colour
